limitations: the window is not closed. An item whose range is never re-run keeps its orphan, and this measurement only shows that a resume repairs one
a repaired creation event is stamped when the repair ran. The event stream regains the item; it does not regain the moment the item was written
reproduction: 22B W3's crash: SIGKILL to the PostgreSQL container, mid-ingest

what_22b_measured.and_never_again: 22B resumed the range immediately afterwards and did not re-count. Under the released code the count would not have moved, which is the defect
what_22b_measured.measured_when: after crash recovery, before the resume
